description: List the aliases of a Lambda function.

function_name.description: The name or ARN of the Lambda function whose aliases to list.

function_version.description: Optional function version to filter aliases by, sent as the FunctionVersion query parameter.

marker.description: Optional pagination marker from a previous response, sent as the Marker query parameter.

max_items.description: Optional maximum number of aliases to return, sent as the MaxItems query parameter.

name: list_aliases
